## Hypothesis

Adding a lower-highs counter (requiring 3 consecutive lower highs) and a role-reversal flag (marking broken levels as flipped resistance/support) will improve the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup's edge by filtering false breakouts and ensuring trades align with genuine bearish structure. This should increase capture on winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and reduce losses on loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07) by avoiding entries in choppy or reversing markets.

## Mechanism

- **Lower-highs counter:** Track the last 3 bounces at any price level (defined by prior swing highs). Require each bounce to form a lower high (successive highs decreasing) to confirm bearish momentum. Added as a context filter under "SPY structure: bearish".
- **Role-reversal flag:** When a level is broken (close beyond level with volume), mark it as flipped. For bearish setups, only consider a level as valid resistance if: (a) it was previously support and broken upward (now resistance), or (b) it has been tested and held as resistance. Added to the "Level rejection" trigger condition: the tested level must be confirmed resistance (either original or via role reversal).
- Both conditions must be true alongside existing triggers (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence) for entry.
